# Move Back to Africa

> Move Back to Africa is a planning site for the African diaspora created by Ada Eguzouwa, a nurse-turned-agripreneur who builds businesses in Nigeria (Manna Farms, FarmLog, the Agribusiness Investors Club) and runs the personal brand Build With Ada. It helps the African diaspora plan a move or investment back home with free guides, a readiness quiz and practical workbooks.

## Guides
- [Moving Back to Africa: The 2026 Checklist](https://movebacktoafrica.com/guides/moving-back-to-africa-checklist.html): income, budget, land and trust, family, health, schooling, papers, ID and the first 30 days for diaspora returnees.
- [How Much Does It Really Cost to Move Back to Africa?](https://movebacktoafrica.com/guides/how-much-does-it-cost-to-move-back-to-africa.html): the moving, landing, monthly and safety-net costs of moving back to Africa, and how to work out your own number.
- [Are You Ready to Move Back to Africa? 10 Questions to Ask Yourself First](https://movebacktoafrica.com/guides/are-you-ready-to-move-back-to-africa.html): ten readiness questions covering purpose, income, cost, savings, family, trial stay, health, documents, trust and an exit plan.
- [Where Should I Move in Africa? How to Choose Your Country](https://movebacktoafrica.com/guides/where-should-i-move-in-africa.html): eight criteria for choosing a country and city, plus diaspora citizenship and residency routes in Ghana, Sierra Leone, Benin and Guinea-Bissau.
- [Free move-back readiness quiz](https://movebacktoafrica.com/quiz.html): 11 questions that score how ready someone is to move back to Africa.

## Products
- [How to Move Back to Africa: A Relocation Planning Workbook for the African Diaspora]({STAN}): $37. A 55-question readiness checklist and nine worksheets covering income, monthly budget, property and trusted people, the family money talk, documents and national IDs for 21 African countries, a visit plan and a 90-day landing plan.
